edges.reason: msg.sender indexes balances for minting, transfer and transferFrom.
msg.sender indexes allowed when approving and spending allowances.
Constructor assigns the fixed total supply.
Constructor sets the locked guard to true.
Constructor invokes _startNewMiningEpoch to seed the first challenge.
onlyOwner modifier guards the token constructor.
mint credits balances[msg.sender] with the reward.
mint increases tokensMinted by the reward amount.
mint writes the lastRewardTo diagnostic field.
mint writes the lastRewardAmount diagnostic field.
mint reads and writes solutionForChallenge to prevent double rewards.
mint reads challengeNumber when hashing the digest and storing the solution.
mint calls _startNewMiningEpoch after a successful reward.
mint calls getMiningReward to determine reward_amount.
mint uses SafeMath.add for balance and supply updates.
Digest casting and target comparison feed the proof-of-work arithmetic path.
_startNewMiningEpoch advances rewardEra when the era cap would be exceeded.
_startNewMiningEpoch recomputes maxSupplyForEra for the new era.
_startNewMiningEpoch uses getMiningReward for the era-change check.
_startNewMiningEpoch uses SafeMath.add for epoch and supply arithmetic.
Block-number subtraction and percentage scaling produce the new target without checked math.
_reAdjustDifficulty uses SafeMath.sub on target and percentage values.
_reAdjustDifficulty uses ExtendedMath.limitLessThan to cap the adjustment.
Difficulty readjustment depends on miner-influenced block context (block.number).
transferOwnership stages the new owner address.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender == newOwner to authorise the handover.
transfer debits and credits the balances mapping.
totalSupply subtracts the burned balance of address(0).
approveAndCall writes the allowance before the callback.
approveAndCall performs an external call into the spender contract via receiveApproval.
transferAnyERC20Token performs an external call into an arbitrary token contract.
transferAnyERC20Token sends the rescued tokens to owner.
getMiningReward reads rewardEra as the halving exponent.
getMintDigest hashes msg.sender into the debug digest.
checkMintSolution hashes msg.sender into the candidate digest.
transfer uses SafeMath.sub for the sender balance.
transfer uses SafeMath.add for the recipient balance.
transferFrom uses SafeMath.sub for balances and allowance.
transferFrom uses SafeMath.add for the recipient balance.

mint reads the stored solution local variable.
mint computes the reward_amount local variable.
